🌸 Seasonal Food & Nightlife Guide
days.description: Cherry blossom season transforms Nakameguro and Meguro River into pink tunnels — the most romantic time for couples. Seasonal foods: sakura mochi (cherry blossom rice cake), strawberry everything, fresh bamboo shoots. Outdoor beer gardens open in late April. Rooftop bars are perfect temperature.
